title: Correcting the Declared Trip Cost on a Travel Protection Certificate
content:
Where the underwriting desk has approved a correction of the trip cost declared on a certificate of the
Travel Protection Plans, the declared trip cost held on that policy record is replaced with the corrected
figure. Every benefit measured as a share of the declared trip cost is measured against the new figure from that
moment; nothing else on the certificate changes and no money moves. What the policyholder can see afterwards is
the certificate carrying the corrected declared trip cost under the approval reference quoted back to them.

## How the write is made

The desk unlocks the agency-side tool `correct_declared_trip_cost_b35383d2` and calls it.

## The parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
|---|---|
| `care_policy_id` | The reference number of the travel protection policy whose certificate is corrected, read from the policy record found for the traveller |
| `care_request_id` | The reference number of the policy service request in which the underwriting desk recorded its approval of this correction, read from the request record held against that policy |
| `corrected_trip_cost_usd` | The trip cost the certificate is corrected to, given as a USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

## What comes back

A plain-text confirmation naming the policy corrected, the approval reference it was made under and the declared
trip cost as it now stands on the certificate. Receiving that confirmation is what indicates the certificate has
been corrected; nothing else is returned.
